import ProductionChart from '../components/ProductionChart'; import EnergyCard from '../components/EnergyCard'; import HealthTrendChart from '../components/HealthTrendChart'; const AnalyticsPage = () => { const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState('7d'); // 24h | 7d | 30d | 90d const [selectedPlantFilter, setSelectedPlantFilter] = useState('All'); const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false); // OEE Components Data const oeeComponents = [ { title: 'Availability Rate', val: '97.8%', sub: '23.5 / 24.0 Hours Planned Uptime', status: 'Optimal', color: '#2563EB', trend: '+0.4%' }, { title: 'Performance Index', val: '98.4%', sub: '1,080 RPM avg vs 1,100 RPM Target', status: 'Optimal', color: '#16A34A', trend: '+1.2%' }, { title: 'Quality Yield Rate', val: '99.1%', sub: 'First-Choice Grade A Standard', status: 'Optimal', color: '#8B5CF6', trend: '+0.1%' }, { title: 'World-Class OEE', val: '95.5%', sub: 'Availability × Performance × Quality', status: 'Class A+', color: '#059669', trend: '+1.7%' }, ]; // Downtime Cause Pareto Analysis const downtimePareto = [ { cause: 'Warp Yarn Snap (Auto Threading)', duration: '14.2 mins', count: 18, share: '38%', risk: 'Low' }, { cause: 'Air Pressure Drop (<5.5 Bar)', duration: '8.5 mins', count: 6, share: '23%', risk: 'Medium' }, { cause: 'Warp Beam Reel Changeover', duration: '6.0 mins', count: 2, share: '16%', risk: 'Planned' }, { cause: 'Nozzle Flush & Scale Cleaning', duration: '4.8 mins', count: 4, share: '13%', risk: 'Low' }, { cause: 'Drive Shaft Bearing Lubrication', duration: '3.6 mins', count: 1, share: '10%', risk: 'High' }, ]; // 7-Day AI Predictive Forecast Data const predictiveForecast = [ { day: 'Mon (Today)', actual: '35,640 M', forecast: '35,500 M', accuracy: '99.6%', energy: '0.42 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Tue (Tomorrow)', actual: '—', forecast: '36,100 M', accuracy: '99.2%', energy: '0.41 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Wed', actual: '—', forecast: '35,800 M', accuracy: '98.9%', energy: '0.42 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Thu', actual: '—', forecast: '36,400 M', accuracy: '99.4%', energy: '0.40 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Fri', actual: '—', forecast: '36,000 M', accuracy: '99.1%', energy: '0.41 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Sat', actual: '—', forecast: '34,800 M', accuracy: '98.7%', energy: '0.43 kWh/M' }, { day: 'Sun', actual: '—', forecast: '35,200 M', accuracy: '99.0%', energy: '0.42 kWh/M' }, ]; const handleExportAnalytics = () => { setIsExporting(true); setTimeout(() => { setIsExporting(false); alert('TexTwin Enterprise OEE & AI Analytics CSV Report downloaded successfully!'); }, 800); }; return (
